prerequisite: Five exact text files and this plan must be published and read back on authorized source/delivery branches before execution. Independent review must close before publication.
purpose: Single finite cloud Debug validation of the opt-in safety layer and ordinary notified null-device lifecycle. No system device, Windows or microphone execution.

parameters.REPO: Exact clean candidate tree with fixed miniaudio/Ogg/Opus pins and16verified authored WAV inputs
parameters.RUN_GUARDED: Original verified guard with SHA below
parameters.OUTPUT: Fresh nonexistent local guard output directory outside source

bounds.native: Two independent real Host cycles; total active Play walltime at least2seconds, not frame-only. Play/Stop/tail/Close each20seconds deadline. OuterTERM10secondgrace thenKILL; no cleanup inferred from termination.
bounds.storage: Fixed610UI diagnostic rows and scalar callback counters; no PCM retention or whole-history capture.
bounds.callback: Test-only output zero-init and bounded per-sample sanitize/gain/clamp, no clock reads/allocations/locks/I/O/waits.

prechecks: Exact clean tree, officialZigversion, guardhash and source-manifest file hashes. Preserve existing phase2 ELF/tape untouched.
Verify16 authored WAV source inputs before and after with prepare_live_fixtures.py --verify-only, each60seconds. No replacement of existing mismatches.
Ensure no otherSME variables inherited; mode exactlynull, gain exactly0, no physical fallback. Guard output must not preexist.
required: Twelve named harness tests: explicit null2second2cycle ordinaryHost run; closed config/budgets; final output mute/scale/clamp/nonfinite arithmetic; callbackcounter/discontinuity andcapacity failures; heartbeat meanings; preowner invalidgain and semantic/capture guard rejection; four exact device-helper regressions for disabledbits/fallback initialization/binding/nativecallback error paths.

Per actual cycle require genuine Play/Stop terminal/ACK, closed/join/destroy, provideropened=closed=16/live0/leases0/instances0 and empty first_error/cleanup_error. Read callback-owned safety stats only after genuine destruction; failedcleanup retains pinned context and is not successful.

Each cycle pre-safety finite nonzero samples/peak, post-safety zero muted PCM, no nonfinite/clamp/fallback/invalidshape/frame discontinuity/epochchange/internal streamfault. Control observes its existing streamfault counter without extraengine read. Callbackfactcounts andPCM/samplecounts must match.

Flat actual stderr must include config null/gain0/cycles2, two CLOSED/OUTPUT/NEGOTIATED records, complete active_ns>=2e9, backendnull/stereo, retained diagnostic rowcount consistent with emitted SAMPLE lines, no overflow/write truncation. Values are UI-observed progress/poll gaps, not precise callback jitter/OSxruns/acoustic evidence.

Default-mode regressions and semantic-process selftests pass with mode unset; external semantic recording/replay integration is intentionally skipped, not counted as new protocol qualification. Production archive compiles with guard/observers stripped.
Source/fixture postchecks and actual result exit/timeout/process cleanup inspected. Preserve failure if compileerror, runtimefault, deadline, resourceleak or missing evidence.
failure_policy: One invocation on this tree, no timing reroll or altered bounds/assertions. A concrete failure is archived and diagnosed before any corrected-source attempt. Unknown/interrupted remains UNKNOWN.
following: Only after this cloud result passes may a separately frozen Windows system-default muted hardware plan be reviewed. Hardware startup is not authorized by this cloud plan.
limits: Stage2 finite optimized Linux long capture/fresh/negatives belong to source8c92/tree675f10d, no inherited qualification for this tree.
Muted device output cannot establish speakers, hearing, physical volume, acoustic uninterrupted audio or OSunderrun counters.
Current Host has no pause/resume or device-ID selection. Cycles are Stop/Close/newHost, not transportpause or device switching.
No source/output injection, buffer expansion, production supply change, main modification, rawlog/audio/ELF/tape upload, OSvolume/deviceconfiguration change.
